players.product: Electron small launch and Neutron medium-lift launch vehicle (in development)

quarterly_data.signal: Rocket Lab 10-K: on December 17, 2025 Rocket Lab agreed with the Space Development Agency to design, manufacture and provide operations and sustainment for 18 satellites for the Tracking Layer Tranche 3 program; total potential value $816 million ($806 million base plus $10 million options), final delivery expected in 2029.

Rocket Lab 10-K: as of December 31, 2025 Electron had launched successfully 75 times and deployed over 200 spacecraft; Neutron qualification testing is ongoing, and an unanticipated failure during qualification testing of the first stage tank in January 2026 impacted the expected timing of Neutron's first launch.

Rocket Lab 10-K: the top five customers accounted for approximately 49% of 2025 revenue and the top five backlog customers for approximately 77% of backlog; a government customer accounted for 28% of 2025 revenue.
